snippet.title: Sevenfall — Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
New game coming soon! 
A turn-based strategy RPG with deck-building, fortress construction, and intense battles against legendary factions. Explore dangerous domains, conquer ancient keys, and face Ulthar, the Dark Trinity, in a journey where every choice shapes your destiny.

Add it to your Steam wishlist!
